description:
Egans are delighted to present Kilpatrick Manor, Mullingar an impressive four-bedroom detached family residence extending to approximately 2,300 sq.ft and set on a mature site of approximately 0.54 acres to the open market for sale.

Ideally located in the townland of Kilpatrick, a short distance from Mullingar town centre, the property combines the space and privacy of countryside living with convenient access to an excellent range of local amenities. St Kenny National School, Shandonagh GAA Club, Mullingar Equestrian Centre & Lough Ennell are all on its doorstep.

Kilpatrick Manor offers bright, spacious and well-proportioned accommodation. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, living room, dining room, kitchen, sunroom, utility room and guest WC. The excellent selection of living and reception areas provides ample space for everyday family life as well as entertaining.

The first floor comprises four generously sized bedrooms, each benefiting from its own en-suite. This is an excellent feature for a family home, providing comfort and privacy for both family members and guests.

The second floor provides valuable additional storage space and further enhances the practicality of this substantial residence.

Externally, the property occupies a mature site extending to approximately 0.54 acres. The south-facing rear garden is a particular highlight, offering generous outdoor space for recreation, entertaining and family enjoyment. A large garden shed provides further useful storage.

The property has a C-rated BER and is serviced by oil-fired central heating, mains water and a septic tank.

Offering approximately 2,300 sq.ft of accommodation, four en-suite bedrooms and a mature south-facing garden, Kilpatrick Manor represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a substantial family home in a peaceful setting just minutes from Mullingar.

Viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment with Egans.
